text:
Anika: morning team — quick async round.
Anika: yesterday: finished the sample-chat README rewrite and pushed doc snippets to the quickstart. PR #4823 is up for review.
Ben: saw the PR, left comments on the auth section. small wording + token example.
Carlos: blockers: local sample app fails on M1 during `npm run build` — node-gyp error. investigating.
Maya: thanks for flagging — for M1 we added a note in the internal dev guide, but not the public quickstart. can you paste the error?
Carlos: "gyp ERR! stack Error: `make` failed with exit code 2" — native deps. workaround is `arch -x86_64 npm install` but that's ugly for docs.
Anika: for the public quickstart let's add an optional mac note rather than full workaround. keep main flow simple.
Ben: FYI I deployed a small mkdocs config fix to the staging docs site to address sidebar jumping. might explain failing docs build on CI.
deploy-bot: docs-build #docs-site: build queued (staging) — job 7821.
Maya: action items for today: 1) Ben — merge the mkdocs patch if green, 2) Carlos — try containerized build and report error text for the PR, 3) Anika — update quickstart with short M1 note and token example tweak.
Carlos: will try container build now, ETA ~2h. ping me in-thread with reviewers.
Ben: if CI is flaky I'll open a follow-up PR to pin mkdocs to 1.5.x — that fixed a similar thing last month.
Anika: tagging @Maya for docs review when I push the quickstart tweak. will also add a tiny snippet: `pip install redwood-sdk` and a one-liner JS example.
Maya: ack — can review later today. also can someone double-check the sample-chat license file? noticed a missing header.
Anika: will add license header in the same PR.
Ben: quick note: codeowners had `samples/*` assigned to eng-platform, so I added eng-platform as a reviewer to avoid bottlenecks.
Carlos: container build succeeded with node:18-bullseye, so I'll add Docker-note to the troubleshooting section.
Anika: perfect. thanks all — ping in-thread if you need an unblock. :rocket:
Maya: tiny follow-up: can we also include a short troubleshooting FAQ with 3 bullets (M1, node version, and auth tokens)? I'll draft it after lunch.
Anika: sounds good. I'll aim to merge PR #4823 by EOD if no blockers.
Ben: :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: docs-build #docs-site: staging build succeeded — job 7821 — link: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/changes/7821
Anika: nice! will pull staging and sanity-check the sidebar before merging.
Maya: ok closing my loop — good progress.
